name: default-agent-launcher
task_summary: Make Default Agent affect New Tab launcher

spawn_spec.prompt:
TASK: Implement a real, observable Default Agent behavior for Ferryx. This is an executable assignment.
DELIVERABLE: The agent selected as `defaultAgentId` in Settings must affect the New Tab agent launcher: when that selected agent is enabled and available, it must render first and show an accessible visible `Default` label. It must still launch exactly the clicked agent, and unavailable/disabled/missing defaults must gracefully leave natural agent order with no Default badge. Settings copy must accurately state this precise behavior rather than claiming auto-launch. Add failing-first focused tests that demonstrate ordering, Default label, click callback identity, and no badge for ineligible/missing default; then make them GREEN.
SCOPE: You may edit ONLY `ui/src/components/NewTabPopover.tsx`, `ui/src/components/NewTabPopover.test.tsx`, `ui/src/components/TabBar.tsx`, `ui/src/components/TabBar.test.tsx`, `ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx`, `ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.test.tsx`, `ui/src/App.tsx`, `ui/src/App.test.tsx`, and `ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx`/its test only for exact truthful copy. Do not edit storage keys, Rust, remote lifecycle, colors, other UI components, configs, docs, or commit.
VERIFY: Before production modifications, run exact focused Vitest command(s) and capture a RED failure caused by missing `defaultAgentId` UI behavior. After implementation, run exact GREEN focused tests. Run LSP diagnostics on every touched UI source file. No desktop automation, browser servers, or external network calls.
STOP WHEN: The selected usable default agent is visibly marked and first in the New Tab agent list, click still launches that agent, invalid defaults do not falsely mark agents, tests have RED→GREEN evidence, and you provide commands/results.

<Category_Context>
You are working on tasks that don't fit specific categories but require moderate effort.
</Category_Context>

final_response:
Default Agent now changes the New Tab launcher instead of being a dead Settings preference.

When `defaultAgentId` is enabled and available, that agent is first in the New Tab list with a visible, accessible `Default` label. Click still launches the exact clicked agent object. Missing, `none`, disabled, or unavailable defaults keep natural order and show no badge. Settings copy describes this and does not claim auto-launch.

`defaultAgentId` is wired `App` → `TerminalSplitView` → `TabBar` → `NewTabPopover`.

**RED** (before implementation)

```bash
cd ui && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --maxWorkers=1 \
  src/components/NewTabPopover.test.tsx src/components/TabBar.test.tsx \
  src/components/TerminalSplitView.test.tsx src/components/SettingsDialog.test.tsx \
  src/App.test.tsx \
  -t "defaultAgentId|Default Agent|Default label|exact clicked|natural agent order|surfaces the stored"
```

Failures were the missing UI: first button was `Claude` instead of `Aider`, and Settings still said it does not preselect/launch.

**GREEN** (after implementation)

Same command: **8 passed**, 94 skipped.

`tsc --noEmit` exit 0. LSP diagnostics on the touched UI files timed out after repeated retries.

Unrelated pre-existing failures (not from this change): Settings Ghostty preference spies, and `NewTabPopover.browserTab.runtime.test.tsx` (`__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke` undefined).
